name: maint-evidence-v2
description: Cited evidence chunks from the Tizert maintenance corpus: equipment dossiers, vendor manuals, datasheets, process flow diagrams, engineering and shop drawings, in French and English. Search here for equipment, maintenance, drawing, part and process questions.

filters.filterInstructions: Filter only when the user explicitly asks for one document type: drawing or plan, manufacturer manual (manuel constructeur), technical datasheet (fiche technique), bill of materials (BOM, nomenclature), operating procedure (mode opératoire), preventive maintenance routine (gamme préventive), electrical or instrumentation schematic or P&ID (schéma électrique, instrumentation), lubrication plan (PMP, lubrification), certificate, catalogue, calculation note (note de calcul) or 3D model. Never filter on a topic, an equipment name or a question type alone.

Filter only when the user explicitly names one of these corpus zone folders. Never infer a zone from an equipment tag, an equipment name or a process step: electrical and instrumentation documents of every area are filed under 'Installation électrique & Instrumentation'.
